QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_22

question.text: Under the SEBI Stewardship Code (Principle 5) applicable to AIFs, the fund's voting policy must cover:

answer.text: Voting in proportion to ownership only
Mechanisms of voting, circumstances in which voting should be for/against/abstain, and disclosure of voting

explanation.text: The Logic: Stewardship Code Principle 5 requires a comprehensive voting policy including mechanisms of voting, circumstances in which voting should be for/against/abstain, and disclosure of voting. AIFs must take their OWN voting decisions after in-depth analysis — not blindly support management. The Trap: Options A, B and C are narrow/wrong interpretations of Principle 5. The wording is tested verbatim. Note: The workbook fixes Principle 5's voting-policy elements; activist-strategy voting-record commentary is not part of the syllabus.
